correctness.rationale: The XLindley density at rate theta>0 decomposes by direct coefficient comparison into a Gamma(1,theta) / Gamma(2,theta) mixture with weights a=theta(theta+2)/(1+theta)^2 and b=1/(1+theta)^2, a+b=1. A sum of two independent same-rate gamma-mixtures has shapes 2/3/4 and weights a^2, 2ab, b^2. Poisson-gamma integration gives the stated three NB mixture. Separately Poisson(Y1+Y2) equals in law independent Poisson(Y1)+Poisson(Y2), so the defined PTS-XL model equals PXL convolved with PXL; PGF squares. Independent symbolic exact-rational algebra checked a+b, the gamma density, the PXL PGF formula and the NB-mixture generating function for indeterminate theta,z. This is correct mathematics on theta>0.
